black-scholes/cuda: Prices the seven base contracts and expands homogeneous scaled copies on the GPU; not independent-option pricing throughput. Completion is synchronized; result download is outside the timer.
black-scholes/hybrid: Prices seven base contracts before timing, then distributes GPU expansion of scaled copies. MPI maximum covers the completed expansion, not general option-price evaluation.
black-scholes/mpi: Caches invariant contract coefficients but retains per-option log/CDF pricing. Reviewed local partition, reduction and output assembly; actual 128-rank case passed.
black-scholes/omp: Retains full per-option formula with vectorized CPU execution; odd option-count case passed. No additional workload omission identified.
cahn-hilliard/cuda: Captures requested evolution steps in a CUDA graph before timing and executes the graph inside timing; odd noncubic case passed. Graph construction and final host copy are outside the device interval.
cahn-hilliard/hybrid: Reviewed slab ownership, neighbor exchange, two-stage update and corrected maximum-rank timing; odd noncubic evolution passed.
cahn-hilliard/mpi: Reviewed periodic halos and communication-dependent evolution; odd noncubic case passed at both four and 128 ranks.
cahn-hilliard/omp: Size/cache-dependent fused path is absent from ordinary small validation. Both odd noncubic case and measured-size 512-cubed fused path with three steps passed.
cholesky/cuda: Prepares a factorization CUDA graph before timing; actual factorization and graph transfers execute inside timing. Full reconstruction internal check shares arithmetic machinery with input creation, so it is not a fully independent oracle.
cholesky/hybrid: Uses shared-memory MPI windows on the one-node system; reviewed factorization and corrected maximum-rank interval. Odd matrix size and residual/external comparisons passed.
cholesky/mpi: Uses shared-memory MPI factorization rather than a general inter-node solver. Odd matrix size passed at four and 128 ranks with unchanged residual and external checks.
cholesky/omp: Tile size changes from 48 to 96 above n=1536. Both n=513 remainder case and n=1537 larger-tile path passed.
floydwarshall/cuda: Computes distances but drops the unobserved predecessor/path matrix. Remainder case passed; the sparse integer external oracle remains weak.
floydwarshall/hybrid: Uses lossless bounded-distance encoding and shared-memory work; retains path updates. Remainder case passed. Output/path assembly placement follows the existing reviewed timing contract.
floydwarshall/mpi: Drops unobserved path updates while computing distances. Remainder case passed at four and 128 ranks; fixed sparse output samples cannot certify the full distance matrix.
floydwarshall/omp: Retains distance and path updates with blocked CPU work. Remainder case passed; shares the same sparse distance-only external oracle.
matmul/cuda: Reviewed tiled full dot products, edge guards and completion; n=513 passed. Internal spot checks and external summaries are not full independent matrix comparison.
matmul/hybrid: Untimed CPU/GPU trials choose the split, then the full timed product is recomputed. Shared windows and explicit affinity widening specialize local execution; no extra physical-core use was established.
matmul/mpi: Creates deterministic A rows and B columns locally before timing, avoiding timed panel exchange. Full dot products retained; odd size passed at four and 128 ranks.
matmul/omp: Reviewed packing, tile tails and full product computation. Odd matrix size passed; no additional workload omission identified.
nbody/cuda: Reviewed full pairwise force work, requested time-step loop, tail handling and device completion. Odd body and step counts passed.
nbody/hybrid: Reviewed force partition, position exchange and time-step loop. Affinity helper can widen the launcher mask; the explicit OMP thread count remains honored. No resource overuse demonstrated.
nbody/mpi: Reviewed distributed force work and per-step position exchange. Odd body and step counts passed at four and 128 ranks.
nbody/omp: Reviewed pairwise force reduction and requested step count; odd body and step counts passed. Printed energy is diagnostic, not a conservation gate.
qtclustering/cuda: Prunes distances/candidates instead of materializing every pair; reduced-precision filtering has double-precision fallback. Nondefault threshold and odd point count passed; this is not proof for every threshold.
qtclustering/hybrid: Reviewed greedy candidate selection, member maintenance and the corrected interval including required preprocessing. Nondefault threshold and odd point count passed.
qtclustering/mpi: Prunes candidate work while retaining greedy selection/communication. Nondefault threshold and odd point count passed at four and 128 ranks.
qtclustering/omp: Uses candidate/member reuse and neighbor pruning; no requirement to materialize a quadratic distance matrix. Nondefault threshold and odd point count passed.
roomsim/cuda: Retains visibility traversal and sequential random stream via jump-ahead; reviewed pair generation, propagation and correlation. Changed scene/time/source/reflectivity case passed existing coarse distance checks.
roomsim/hybrid: Convex-icosphere specialization removes octree visibility traversal; replaces the original random stream with counter-based hash samples. Keeps 16 samples per pair and propagation. Passed existing coarse distance checks, not sample-by-sample semantic equivalence.
roomsim/mpi: Retains visibility traversal and sequential random stream via jump-ahead; reviewed distributed work and corrected interval. Changed scene/time/source/reflectivity case passed at four and 128 ranks.
roomsim/omp: Computes each unordered pair once and mirrors the Monte Carlo estimate. Reciprocity permits the physical symmetry, but sampling correlation differs from independent ordered-pair estimates. Existing coarse distance checks passed.
spmv/cuda: Persistent kernel explicitly loops over all requested repetitions of immutable A times x; odd-size case passed. Final output alone cannot verify the repetition count.
spmv/hybrid: CUDA graphs batch 64 iterations with explicit tail handling. Both odd-size case and 67-iteration graph-plus-tail case passed; output alone cannot verify repetitions.
spmv/mpi: Explicit requested iteration loop retains repeated local SpMV. Odd-size case passed at four and 128 ranks; final output alone cannot verify repetitions.
spmv/omp: Persistent team repeats row products using fixed static ownership and nowait; no cross-row dependency. Odd-size case passed; final output alone cannot verify repetitions.
stencil3d/cuda: Reviewed boundary handling, step count, ping-pong parity and device completion. Odd noncubic case passed; cubic fixed samples miss the evolving interior.
stencil3d/hybrid: Reviewed shared-memory slab communication, boundaries, parity and corrected timing. Odd noncubic case passed; validation summaries are not full-grid equality.
stencil3d/mpi: Reviewed halo exchange, boundaries and step parity. Odd noncubic case passed at four and 128 ranks; standard cubic samples all lie on fixed boundaries.
stencil3d/omp: Measured-size working set selects non-temporal stores absent from standard validation. Odd noncubic case and 512-cubed streaming path with three steps passed.
unstructured/cuda: Replaces generic adjacency traversal with arithmetic neighbors of the regular generated grid. Boundary-sensitive odd-grid long-evolution case passed; not general unstructured-mesh throughput.
unstructured/hybrid: Specializes regular-grid neighbors and retains distributed halo-dependent evolution. Long-evolution odd-grid case passed in addition to the established boundary supplement.
unstructured/mpi: Specializes regular-grid neighbors. Long-evolution odd-grid case passed at four and 128 ranks; existing boundary-validation supplement remains required.
unstructured/omp: Retains compact adjacency traversal and flux computation rather than replacing connectivity with grid arithmetic. Long-evolution odd-grid case passed.
